worldcombat.skill.celebrate.summary: Throws a party for its very happy trainer: confetti and streamers burst out, and every friendly nearby (itself included) is caught up in it, carrying a Celebrating mark. The Cheer form gives everyone a brief burst of travel (faster on the move, lost the moment they are hit); the Treat form hands out health based on how hurt each ally is. It does nothing at all to enemies and grants no attack.
worldcombat.skill.celebrate.use.0: Gather the team for a party after a fight and share the rest
worldcombat.skill.celebrate.use.1: While briefly safe, get the whole team moving faster to march on
worldcombat.skill.celebrate.use.2: In a bad spot, give wounded allies health in proportion to their wounds
Confetti spreads to a radius of %1$s blocks; every friendly inside (itself included) gains the Cheer or Treat benefit at the moment of the cast and carries the Celebrating mark for %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.celebrate.vigor.on: Treat form: each celebrated friendly recovers %1$s of its own missing health (the more hurt, the more it gets); this party grants no travel burst.
worldcombat.skill.celebrate.vigor.off: Cheer form: each celebrated friendly gains a travel burst of +%2$s movement speed for %1$s; any damage taken ends it at once, and this party restores no health.
Wind-up %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s; the move is cheap enough to use often.
worldcombat.skill.celebrate.timing: The party reaches %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, %4$s PP and cooldown %5$s s from commit. It only affects friendlies.
worldcombat.skill.celebrate.preference.v: On (Treat): every friendly caught recovers health in proportion to its own wounds, the more hurt the better, but gains no travel burst. Off (Cheer): everyone gains a brief movement boost that any hit ends, but no health is restored. Each direction has its moment.
worldcombat.skill.celebrate.preference.a: The partner will not start a party while a hostile is inside this range; smaller parties closer in, larger waits until the team is truly out of contact.
At least this many friendlies (itself included) must be nearby to celebrate; 1 parties even alone, larger waits for a crowd.
When on, the partner will also leave its post to throw a party for the team.
world_combat.move.celebrate.text.cheer: Celebrate! %1$s allies gain a travel burst
